content: In what ways does Relation Extraction go beyond what Named Entity Recognition accomplishes?

**Relation Extraction and NER**

• Relation Extraction (RE) is a subtask of information extraction that goes beyond the capabilities of Named Entity Recognition (NER). RE aims to identify and classify the relationships between entities, whereas NER focuses solely on recognizing and categorizing entities themselves (Zelenko et al., 2003).
• RE requires analyzing the context in which entities are mentioned to determine their relationships, such as "John is married to Mary" or "Company X acquired Company Y". This involves more complex processing than simple entity recognition.
• Named Entity Recognition can identify individual entities like person names, organizations, and locations, but it does not establish connections between them, which is the primary goal of Relation Extraction (Zhang et al., 2004).
